scenario: LUNI.8.4 — `//` (floor division) of two dim'd values is ambiguous, same as `/`. `r.dist // r.dist_b` (length // length) rejects with DS_VALIDATE_DIM_AMBIGUOUS. Authors use a typed-let or `Float(...)` strip to opt out.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    a: meter key
    b: meter mutable

rule bad:
    P p where (p.a // p.b) > 1
->
    log info "never"
